own_solution.law: Reversible engine with finite hot body: dW = dQ_h (1 - T0/T); total W = m c [(T1 - T0) - T0 ln(T1/T0)] (entropy of universe constant)
assumptions: tank insulated so all heat leaving water goes through engine

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: TC03C and T557D say 'a small amount' instead of '1.4 kg', so if they are meant as variants of TE3D6/T24C4 they differ in the stated quantity, not only attachment.

notes: W = 8372 J/K x [70 - 290 ln(360/290)] = 8372 x (70 - 62.7047) = 8372 x 7.2953 = 61076 J (about 61.1 kJ). With 3.4 kg: 14232.4 x 7.2953 = 103830 J. 'Same temperature' for the second tank is presumably 360 K; irrelevant since that tank has no path to the engine. Whether the 'small amount' renderings are intended as vague-quantity variants is to be checked in pass 2.
